purpose: test outcome-blind conservative mechanism dispatch or abstention on a second unused P0 family

outcome_scoring.correctness_first: an action must pass hidden correctness in both repetitions
outcome_scoring.performance_eligibility: task median no more than 1.25x the fastest correct action
outcome_scoring.cost_choice: lowest median complete input plus output tokens among eligible actions
outcome_scoring.routing_space: different task actions and at least 15% Worker saving versus the best fixed eligible Profile, or no fixed Profile eligible on both tasks

router_scoring.reveal_time: after Router responses and Worker outcomes are immutable
router_scoring.abstain_resolution: dispatch neutral as the zero-token safe fixed action
router_scoring.safe_abstention: neutral is performance-eligible on the revealed task
router_scoring.missed_utility: abstention is safe but a different eligible action is materially cheaper
router_scoring.mechanism_precision: every dispatched mechanism directly preserves the revealed task semantics

failure_policy.invalid_router_response: Router repetition failure and no reinterpretation

claim_boundary: Frequency labels are absent from Router workspaces and expected routes remain null. The mechanism catalog intentionally lacks a Frequency-specific count index, so the experiment tests conservative abstention under incomplete evidence rather than broad mechanism discovery.
